hallucination.reason: No facts, numbers, or details were stated beyond the approved knowledge base.

overclaim.reason: The agent did not guarantee or promise anything not subject to verification and correctly hedged their statements.

interruption_recovery.reason: The agent remained patient and on track despite the caller's hesitation and mumbling.

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within their role and knowledge base, without inventing services or opinions.

escalation.reason: There were no out-of-scope requests that required escalation or transfer.
